content.json:
# ArcBox FleetOps — Azure Arc fleet observability

> **Fictional technical SRE demo. Not an official Mercadona system. All stores, products, prices, carts, orders, correlation IDs and metrics are synthetic; no claims about real operations.**

Este workbook muestra el **inventario, la conectividad, la salud de agentes y el consumo de recursos** de todo el parque de servidores conectados con **Azure Arc**, y es la misma telemetría que consume **Azure SRE Agent** para investigar incidentes.

| Máquina Arc real | Rol de demo (etiqueta) | Host ficticio | Sitio |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ArcBox-Win2K22` | `adfs` | `adfs-01` | `site-a` |
| `ArcBox-Win2K25` | `domain-controller` | `dc-01` | `site-a` |
| `ArcBox-SQL` | `identity-sql` | `sql-01` | `site-b` |
| `Arcbox-Ubuntu-01` | `linux-edge` | `edge-01` | `site-b` |
| `Arcbox-Ubuntu-02` | `linux-edge` | `edge-02` | `site-b` |

Los roles `adfs` y `domain-controller` son **etiquetas de presentación**: estas máquinas no ejecutan AD FS ni AD DS. Sirven para representar el patrón de operación del parque on-prem del cliente.

content.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines' | where resourceGroup =~ 'rg-arcbox-itpro-weu-002' | extend Status = tostring(properties.status), OsName = tostring(properties.osName), AgentVersion = tostring(properties.agentVersion) | project Machine = name, Status, Detalle = strcat(OsName, ' · agente ', AgentVersion) | order by Machine asc
content.title: Conectividad por servidor Arc

content.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines' | where resourceGroup =~ 'rg-arcbox-itpro-weu-002' | extend MachineKey = tolower(name) | extend Status = tostring(properties.status), OsName = tostring(properties.osName), OsVersion = tostring(properties.osVersion), OsType = tostring(properties.osType), AgentVersion = tostring(properties.agentVersion), LastStatusChange = todatetime(properties.lastStatusChange), Domain = tostring(properties.domainName), Manufacturer = tostring(properties.detectedProperties.manufacturer), Model = tostring(properties.detectedProperties.model), LogicalCores = toint(properties.detectedProperties.logicalCoreCount), TotalPhysicalMemoryGb = toint(properties.detectedProperties.totalPhysicalMemoryInGigabytes) | join kind=leftouter ( datatable(MachineKey: string, DemoRole: string, DemoHost: string, DemoSite: string) [ 'arcbox-win2k22', 'adfs', 'adfs-01', 'site-a', 'arcbox-win2k25', 'domain-controller', 'dc-01', 'site-a', 'arcbox-sql', 'identity-sql', 'sql-01', 'site-b', 'arcbox-ubuntu-01', 'linux-edge', 'edge-01', 'site-b', 'arcbox-ubuntu-02', 'linux-edge', 'edge-02', 'site-b' ] ) on MachineKey | project Machine = name, DemoRole = coalesce(DemoRole, 'unmapped'), DemoHost = coalesce(DemoHost, 'unmapped'), DemoSite = coalesce(DemoSite, 'unmapped'), Status, OsType, OsName, OsVersion, AgentVersion, LogicalCores, TotalPhysicalMemoryGb, Domain, Manufacturer, Model, MinutosDesdeUltimoCambio = toint(datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastStatusChange)) | order by DemoRole asc, Machine asc
content.title: Inventario del parque Arc (rol de demo, SO, agente, capacidad)

content.json:
## 2. Salud de agentes y extensiones

Cada capacidad (telemetría, change tracking, Defender, Update Manager) se entrega como una extensión de Arc. Aquí se ve el estado real de aprovisionamiento, sin modificar nada.

content.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/extensions' | where resourceGroup =~ 'rg-arcbox-itpro-weu-002' | extend MachineKey = tostring(split(tolower(id), '/')[8]) | extend Extension = name, Publisher = tostring(properties.publisher), ExtensionType = tostring(properties.type), ProvisioningState = tostring(properties.provisioningState), TypeHandlerVersion = tostring(properties.typeHandlerVersion), EnableAutomaticUpgrade = tobool(properties.enableAutomaticUpgrade) | extend Capability = case(ExtensionType contains 'AzureMonitor', 'telemetry-ama', ExtensionType contains 'DependencyAgent', 'telemetry-dependency', ExtensionType contains 'ChangeTracking', 'change-tracking', ExtensionType contains 'MDE', 'defender-endpoint', ExtensionType contains 'SqlServer' or ExtensionType contains 'AdvancedThreatProtection', 'sql-arc', ExtensionType contains 'PatchExtension' or ExtensionType contains 'OsUpdate', 'update-manager', ExtensionType contains 'AdminCenter', 'windows-admin-center', ExtensionType contains 'assessment', 'server-assessment', 'other') | project Machine = MachineKey, Capability, Extension, Publisher, ProvisioningState, TypeHandlerVersion, EnableAutomaticUpgrade | order by ProvisioningState asc, Machine asc, Capability asc
content.title: Estado de extensiones Arc (solo lectura)

content.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/extensions' | where resourceGroup =~ 'rg-arcbox-itpro-weu-002' | extend ExtensionType = tostring(properties.type), ProvisioningState = tostring(properties.provisioningState) | extend Capability = case(ExtensionType contains 'AzureMonitor', 'telemetry-ama', ExtensionType contains 'DependencyAgent', 'telemetry-dependency', ExtensionType contains 'ChangeTracking', 'change-tracking', ExtensionType contains 'MDE', 'defender-endpoint', ExtensionType contains 'SqlServer' or ExtensionType contains 'AdvancedThreatProtection', 'sql-arc', ExtensionType contains 'PatchExtension' or ExtensionType contains 'OsUpdate', 'update-manager', ExtensionType contains 'AdminCenter', 'windows-admin-center', ExtensionType contains 'assessment', 'server-assessment', 'other') | summarize Total = count(), Correctas = countif(ProvisioningState =~ 'Succeeded'), ConError = countif(ProvisioningState =~ 'Failed') by Capability | extend PorcentajeCorrecto = round(100.0 * Correctas / Total, 1) | order by ConError desc, Capability asc
content.title: Cobertura de capacidades en el parque

content.query: let LookbackWindow = 24h; let HeartbeatFreshness = Heartbeat | where TimeGenerated >= ago(LookbackWindow) | extend MachineKey = tostring(split(tolower(_ResourceId), '/')[-1]) | summarize UltimoDato = max(TimeGenerated), Muestras = count() by MachineKey, Signal = 'Heartbeat'; let MetricFreshness = InsightsMetrics | where TimeGenerated >= ago(LookbackWindow) | extend MachineKey = tostring(split(tolower(_ResourceId), '/')[-1]) | summarize UltimoDato = max(TimeGenerated), Muestras = count() by MachineKey, Signal = 'InsightsMetrics'; union HeartbeatFreshness, MetricFreshness | extend MinutosDeRetraso = round(datetime_diff('second', now(), UltimoDato) / 60.0, 1) | extend Estado = case(MinutosDeRetraso <= 10, 'Fresco', MinutosDeRetraso <= 60, 'Retrasado', 'Sin datos recientes') | project MachineKey, Signal, Estado, MinutosDeRetraso, Muestras, UltimoDato | order by MachineKey asc, Signal asc
content.title: Frescura de telemetría por servidor y señal (últimas 24 h)

content.json:
## 3. Presión de recursos: CPU y memoria

Estas son las series que evalúan las reglas `alert-arcbox-fleet-cpu-saturation` (CPU ≥ 85 % sostenida) y `alert-arcbox-fleet-memory-pressure` (memoria usada ≥ 80 % sostenida).

content.query: InsightsMetrics | where Namespace == 'Processor' and Name == 'UtilizationPercentage' | extend MachineKey = tostring(split(tolower(_ResourceId), '/')[-1]) | summarize CpuPercent = round(avg(Val), 2) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), MachineKey | order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: CPU media por servidor (bins de 5 min)

content.query: InsightsMetrics | where Namespace == 'Memory' and Name == 'AvailableMB' | extend MachineKey = tostring(split(tolower(_ResourceId), '/')[-1]), TotalMemoryMb = todouble(todynamic(Tags)['vm.azm.ms/memorySizeMB']) | where TotalMemoryMb > 0 | extend MemoryUsedPercent = 100.0 * (TotalMemoryMb - Val) / TotalMemoryMb | summarize MemoryUsedPercent = round(avg(MemoryUsedPercent), 2) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), MachineKey | order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Memoria usada por servidor (bins de 5 min)

content.query: let CpuSaturationPercent = 85.0; let MemoryPressurePercent = 80.0; let CpuSnapshot = InsightsMetrics | where TimeGenerated >= ago(15m) | where Namespace == 'Processor' and Name == 'UtilizationPercentage' | extend MachineKey = tostring(split(tolower(_ResourceId), '/')[-1]) | summarize CpuMedia = round(avg(Val), 1), CpuMaxima = round(max(Val), 1), MuestrasCpuEnUmbral = countif(Val >= CpuSaturationPercent) by MachineKey; let MemorySnapshot = InsightsMetrics | where TimeGenerated >= ago(15m) | where Namespace == 'Memory' and Name == 'AvailableMB' | extend MachineKey = tostring(split(tolower(_ResourceId), '/')[-1]), TotalMemoryMb = todouble(todynamic(Tags)['vm.azm.ms/memorySizeMB']) | where TotalMemoryMb > 0 | extend MemoryUsedPercent = 100.0 * (TotalMemoryMb - Val) / TotalMemoryMb | summarize MemoriaMedia = round(avg(MemoryUsedPercent), 1), MemoriaMaxima = round(max(MemoryUsedPercent), 1), MemoriaLibreMinimaMb = round(min(Val), 0), MuestrasMemoriaEnUmbral = countif(MemoryUsedPercent >= MemoryPressurePercent) by MachineKey; CpuSnapshot | join kind=fullouter MemorySnapshot on MachineKey | extend MachineKey = coalesce(MachineKey, MachineKey1) | join kind=leftouter ( datatable(MachineKey: string, DemoRole: string) [ 'arcbox-win2k22', 'adfs', 'arcbox-win2k25', 'domain-controller', 'arcbox-sql', 'identity-sql', 'arcbox-ubuntu-01', 'linux-edge', 'arcbox-ubuntu-02', 'linux-edge' ] ) on MachineKey | extend Veredicto = case(MuestrasCpuEnUmbral >= 8 and MuestrasMemoriaEnUmbral >= 8, 'CPU y memoria en umbral', MuestrasCpuEnUmbral >= 8, 'CPU en umbral', MuestrasMemoriaEnUmbral >= 8, 'Memoria en umbral', MuestrasCpuEnUmbral > 0 or MuestrasMemoriaEnUmbral > 0, 'Picos aislados', 'Dentro de la linea base') | project Machine = MachineKey, DemoRole = coalesce(DemoRole, 'unmapped'), Veredicto, CpuMedia, CpuMaxima, MuestrasCpuEnUmbral, MemoriaMedia, MemoriaMaxima, MemoriaLibreMinimaMb, MuestrasMemoriaEnUmbral | order by Veredicto asc, Machine asc
content.title: Instantánea de presión — últimos 15 min (lo mismo que evalúan las alertas)

content.query: let CpuSeries = InsightsMetrics | where Namespace == 'Processor' and Name == 'UtilizationPercentage' | extend MachineKey = tostring(split(tolower(_ResourceId), '/')[-1]) | summarize CpuMedia = round(avg(Val), 1), CpuP95 = round(percentile(Val, 95), 1), CpuMaxima = round(max(Val), 1), Muestras = count() by MachineKey; let MemorySeries = InsightsMetrics | where Namespace == 'Memory' and Name == 'AvailableMB' | extend MachineKey = tostring(split(tolower(_ResourceId), '/')[-1]), TotalMemoryMb = todouble(todynamic(Tags)['vm.azm.ms/memorySizeMB']) | where TotalMemoryMb > 0 | extend MemoryUsedPercent = 100.0 * (TotalMemoryMb - Val) / TotalMemoryMb | summarize MemoriaMedia = round(avg(MemoryUsedPercent), 1), MemoriaP95 = round(percentile(MemoryUsedPercent, 95), 1), MemoriaMaxima = round(max(MemoryUsedPercent), 1), MemoriaTotalMb = round(max(TotalMemoryMb), 0) by MachineKey; let DiskLatency = InsightsMetrics | where Namespace == 'LogicalDisk' and Name in ('ReadLatencyMs', 'WriteLatencyMs') | extend MachineKey = tostring(split(tolower(_ResourceId), '/')[-1]) | summarize LatenciaDiscoMediaMs = round(avg(Val), 2), LatenciaDiscoP95Ms = round(percentile(Val, 95), 2) by MachineKey; CpuSeries | join kind=leftouter MemorySeries on MachineKey | join kind=leftouter DiskLatency on MachineKey | join kind=leftouter ( datatable(MachineKey: string, DemoRole: string, DemoHost: string) [ 'arcbox-win2k22', 'adfs', 'adfs-01', 'arcbox-win2k25', 'domain-controller', 'dc-01', 'arcbox-sql', 'identity-sql', 'sql-01', 'arcbox-ubuntu-01', 'linux-edge', 'edge-01', 'arcbox-ubuntu-02', 'linux-edge', 'edge-02' ] ) on MachineKey | project Machine = MachineKey, DemoRole = coalesce(DemoRole, 'unmapped'), DemoHost = coalesce(DemoHost, 'unmapped'), CpuMedia, CpuP95, CpuMaxima, MemoriaMedia, MemoriaP95, MemoriaMaxima, MemoriaTotalMb, LatenciaDiscoMediaMs, LatenciaDiscoP95Ms, Muestras | order by DemoRole asc, Machine asc
content.title: Resumen de rendimiento por servidor en la ventana seleccionada

content.query: InsightsMetrics | where Namespace == 'LogicalDisk' and Name == 'FreeSpacePercentage' | extend MachineKey = tostring(split(tolower(_ResourceId), '/')[-1]), Mount = tostring(todynamic(Tags)['vm.azm.ms/mountId']) | where isnotempty(Mount) | where not (Mount startswith '/snap/' or Mount startswith '/sys/' or Mount startswith '/run/') | summarize EspacioLibreMedio = round(avg(Val), 1), EspacioLibreMinimo = round(min(Val), 1), Muestras = count() by MachineKey, Mount | extend Estado = case(EspacioLibreMinimo < 10, 'Critico', EspacioLibreMinimo < 20, 'Atencion', 'Correcto') | project Machine = MachineKey, Mount, Estado, EspacioLibreMedio, EspacioLibreMinimo, Muestras | order by EspacioLibreMinimo asc
content.title: Espacio libre en disco por punto de montaje

content.query: let CpuBaseline = datatable(MachineKey: string, BaselineCpuP95: real, BaselineMemoryP95: real) [ 'arcbox-win2k22', 9.0, 46.5, 'arcbox-win2k25', 16.6, 60.5, 'arcbox-sql', 11.3, 59.6, 'arcbox-ubuntu-01', 1.5, 19.5, 'arcbox-ubuntu-02', 1.5, 19.3 ]; let DailyCpu = InsightsMetrics | where TimeGenerated >= ago(7d) | where Namespace == 'Processor' and Name == 'UtilizationPercentage' | extend MachineKey = tostring(split(tolower(_ResourceId), '/')[-1]) | summarize CpuP95 = round(percentile(Val, 95), 1) by Dia = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), MachineKey; let DailyMemory = InsightsMetrics | where TimeGenerated >= ago(7d) | where Namespace == 'Memory' and Name == 'AvailableMB' | extend MachineKey = tostring(split(tolower(_ResourceId), '/')[-1]), TotalMemoryMb = todouble(todynamic(Tags)['vm.azm.ms/memorySizeMB']) | where TotalMemoryMb > 0 | extend MemoryUsedPercent = 100.0 * (TotalMemoryMb - Val) / TotalMemoryMb | summarize MemoriaP95 = round(percentile(MemoryUsedPercent, 95), 1) by Dia = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), MachineKey; DailyCpu | join kind=inner DailyMemory on MachineKey, Dia | join kind=leftouter CpuBaseline on MachineKey | extend DesviacionCpu = round(CpuP95 - BaselineCpuP95, 1), DesviacionMemoria = round(MemoriaP95 - BaselineMemoryP95, 1) | project Dia, Machine = MachineKey, CpuP95, BaselineCpuP95, DesviacionCpu, MemoriaP95, BaselineMemoryP95, DesviacionMemoria | order by Dia desc, Machine asc
content.title: Tendencia diaria p95 (7 días) frente a la línea base documentada

content.json: ## 5. Cambios, configuración y señales de identidad sintéticas

content.query: union isfuzzy=true (ConfigurationChange | extend MachineKey = tostring(split(tolower(_ResourceId), '/')[-1]) | summarize Cambios = count(), UltimoCambio = max(TimeGenerated) by Machine = MachineKey, TipoDeCambio = tostring(ConfigChangeType)), (datatable(Machine: string, TipoDeCambio: string, Cambios: long, UltimoCambio: datetime) []) | where isnotempty(Machine) | extend TipoDeCambio = iif(isempty(TipoDeCambio), 'sin-clasificar', TipoDeCambio) | project Machine, TipoDeCambio, Cambios, UltimoCambio | order by Cambios desc
content.title: Change Tracking: cambios detectados por servidor y tipo

content.query: union isfuzzy=true (Event | where Source == 'MercadonaSyntheticIdentity' | extend MachineKey = tolower(Computer) | summarize Eventos = count(), UltimoEvento = max(TimeGenerated) by Machine = MachineKey, EventID), (datatable(Machine: string, EventID: int, Eventos: long, UltimoEvento: datetime) []) | where isnotempty(Machine) | extend Escenario = case(EventID == 4101, 'Fallo de federacion sintetico', EventID == 4102, 'Recuperacion sintetica', 'Otro') | project Machine, EventID, Escenario, Eventos, UltimoEvento | order by UltimoEvento desc
content.title: Eventos sintéticos del escenario de identidad Arc (origen MercadonaSyntheticIdentity)

content.json:
## 6. Reglas de alerta y alertas activas

Cuando una regla `ArcBox FleetOps` se dispara, el filtro de incidentes `arc-fleet-performance-sev2` entrega el incidente a **Azure SRE Agent**, que investiga en modo **Review** y propone recomendaciones sin ejecutar cambios.

content.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.insights/scheduledqueryrules' | extend DisplayName = tostring(properties.displayName), Severity = toint(properties.severity), Enabled = tobool(properties.enabled), EvaluationFrequency = tostring(properties.evaluationFrequency), WindowSize = tostring(properties.windowSize), AutoMitigate = tobool(properties.autoMitigate) | where DisplayName startswith 'ArcBox' | project Regla = name, DisplayName, Severity, Enabled, EvaluationFrequency, WindowSize, AutoMitigate, ResourceGroup = resourceGroup | order by DisplayName asc
content.title: Reglas de alerta del escenario Arc

content.query: alertsmanagementresources | where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts' | extend AlertRule = tostring(properties.essentials.alertRule), Severity = tostring(properties.essentials.severity), MonitorCondition = tostring(properties.essentials.monitorCondition), AlertState = tostring(properties.essentials.alertState), StartTime = todatetime(properties.essentials.startDateTime), LastModified = todatetime(properties.essentials.lastModifiedDateTime) | where AlertRule startswith 'alert-arcbox' | project AlertRule, Severity, MonitorCondition, AlertState, StartTime, LastModified | order by StartTime desc | take 50
content.title: Alertas del parque Arc (histórico reciente del servicio de alertas)

content.json:
---

**Fictional technical SRE demo. Not an official Mercadona system. All stores, products, prices, carts, orders, correlation IDs and metrics are synthetic; no claims about real operations.**

Todas las consultas de este workbook son de **solo lectura y agregadas**. No exponen secretos, credenciales ni datos personales, y no modifican ningún recurso.
